# SPDX 3.0.1 schema and example

`spdx-schema-3-0-1.json` (the JSON schema of SPDX 3.0.1) and `package_sbom.json` (an example SBOM) come
from the SPDX specification, version 3.0.1, by the SPDX working group of the Linux Foundation,
retrieved from https://github.com/spdx/spdx-spec (`schemas/` and `examples/jsonld/`, commit d206df8)
on 8 November 2026. They are provided under the Community Specification License 1.0, and are used here
only to test that the SPDX 3.0.1 documents Provetry writes are valid and that it reads others.
